name: Boyle Energy
hours: Confirm hours on the official site before visiting
description: HVAC service plus oil and propane delivery for Philadelphia, Havertown, West Grove, Wayne, and nearby towns. Philadelphia line 215-878-1111.

hero.headline: Boyle Energy
hero.sub: Official contact page lists 215-878-1111 for Philadelphia and 610-446-2444 for the suburbs. This leftover rebuild uses the Philadelphia line.

items: Heating and air conditioning repair and maintenance, including AC and water heaters
Residential oil delivery with call-in or automatic tank fill
Propane delivery with the same call-in or automatic options
Official contact page publishes 215-878-1111 as the Philadelphia line
Official header also publishes 610-446-2444 as the suburbs line
Havertown pin listed as 40 W Manoa Road, Havertown, Pennsylvania 19083
Service pages name Havertown, West Grove, Wayne, Newtown Square, and Philadelphia

story.heading: About
paragraphs: The official homepage describes Boyle Energy as an HVAC, oil, and propane company in Havertown that also serves Philadelphia.
The leftover Unslop demo used only the suburbs header number. This preview puts the published Philadelphia line on the CTA and map card.

items: Book an appointment or request an estimate from the official site.
Choose oil or propane delivery when you call or set automatic fill when the tank is low.
Confirm which yard or mailbox address applies: Havertown, London Grove / West Grove, or Wayne PMB.

feature.heading: Use the Philadelphia line on leftover 51-75
feature.text: The official contact page labels 215-878-1111 as Philadelphia and 610-446-2444 as Suburbs. The leftover demo showed only the suburbs number.

spotlight.heading: More than one published address
spotlight.text: Official find-us listings include 40 W Manoa Road in Havertown, 210 Chatham Road in London Grove, and 175 Strafford Avenue, Suit 1 PMB 604 in Wayne. The map card uses the Havertown pin.
